evidence_class: in memory inventory and holds with a fixed clock and a real fsynced file journal

fixture_inputs.active_restore: ckpt-restore of active task t-restore under a registered restore hold
fixture_inputs.expired_unreferenced_checkpoint: ckpt-old of finished task t-done, past the swarm native resume age
fixture_inputs.held_task_evidence: evidence-held, raw swarm evidence past its age under an accepted evidence hold
fixture_inputs.personal_retention_policy: personal-retention-1, keeping raw evidence and vectors and expiring previews

interfaces: python -m scripts.swarm_v2.checkpoints.retention plan|collect over a DocumentInventory
metrics: retention_protected_objects counts kept objects by protection reason in each plan

outcomes.observed: case outputs in a, b and c result files from the focused proof run
outcomes.accepted: deletion plans journaled before any removal
outcomes.committed: removals journaled deleted one entry per object
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no live store was collected

remaining_limitations: No backend adapter over the artifact store or the session catalog implements the Inventory and Holds protocols yet; collection of live stores is unproven.
Each object is decided again immediately before its removal; a backend without a conditional delete leaves the window between that decision and the removal.
The collector takes no grant; the calling store owner holds the delete authority and the inventory scope.
compatibility: new modules with no preceding retention protocol; the catalog retain-until-deleted session retention is honoured as never expiring
rollback_rehearsal: B ran collection with destructive collection off: the plan was journaled, nothing was removed, and a later run resumed from that plan
